name: io.github.dinesh210805/brightdata-mcp-studio
description: Bright Data's MCP server, extended with the Scraper Studio lifecycle: build a scraper for any public site, detect when it breaks, repair it, and verify the repair.

environmentVariables.name: API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your API key for Bright Data

environmentVariables.name: PRO_MODE
environmentVariables.description: To enable PRO_MODE - set to true

environmentVariables.name: POLLING_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Polling timeout in seconds for web_data_* tools (default: 600)

environmentVariables.name: BASE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in seconds for base tools (search & scrape). No limit if unset

environmentVariables.name: BASE_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Max retries for base tools on transient errors (0-3, default: 0)
